    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # vertical 5 lines
    for c in range(w):
        rows=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==5]
        if len(rows)>=2 and all(rows[i+1]==rows[i]+1 for i in range(len(rows)-1)):

            pat=[g[r0+dr][c+1:c+1+k] for dr in range(k) for k in []] # placeholder

# simpler: find pattern adjacent to line end
def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def tile_v(c, rstart, rend, pat):  # rows rstart..rend, cols c+1..c+len(pat[0])
        pw=len(pat[0]); ph=len(pat)
        for r in range(rstart, rend+1):
            pr=(r-rend)%ph  # bottom anchored
            for j in range(pw):
                out[r][c+1+j]=pat[pr][j]
    def tile_h(r, cstart, cend, pat):
        ph=len(pat); pw=len(pat[0])
        for c in range(cstart, cend+1):
            pc=(c-cstart)%pw  # left anchored
            for i in range(ph):
                out[r+1+i][c]=pat[i][pc]
    for c in range(w):
        rows=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==5]
        if len(rows)>=2 and all(rows[i+1]==rows[i]+1 for i in range(len(rows)-1)):
            r0=rows[-1]; r1=rows[0]
            # pattern to right or left of bottom row
            if c+1<w and any(g[r0][cc]!=0 for cc in range(c+1,w)):
                pw=0
                cc=c+1
                while cc<w and (g[r0][cc]!=0): pw+=1; cc+=1
                ph=0
                rr=r0
                while rr<h and g[rr][c+1]!=0: ph+=1; rr+=1
                pat=[[g[r][c+1+j] for j in range(pw)] for r in range(r0,r0+ph)]
                tile_v(c, r1, r0, pat)
    for r in range(h):
        cols=[cc for cc in range(w) if g[r][cc]==5]
        if len(cols)>=2 and all(cols[i+1]==cols[i]+1 for i in range(len(cols)-1)):
            c0=cols[0]; c1=cols[-1]
            if any(g[rr][c0-1]!=0 for rr in range(r+1,h)) if c0>0 else False:
                ph=0; rr=r+1
                while rr<h and g[rr][c0-1]!=0: ph+=1; rr+=1
                pw=0; cc=c0-1
                while cc>=0 and g[r+1][cc]!=0: pw+=1; cc-=1
                pat=[[g[r+1+i][c0-pw] for i in range(ph)] for _ in range(0)]
                pat=[[g[r+1+i][cc2] for cc2 in range(c0-pw,c0)] for i in range(ph)]
                tile_h(r, c0, c1, pat)
    return out
